exceptions.title: should round to explicit maximumFractionDigits on blur
exceptions.reason: A focus and a blur with no typed edit change no value, as for a native input: a form is not dirty because the user moved through it. The blur rounds a typed number, and each step rounds its result. The case "a focus and a blur with no typed edit change nothing and emit nothing, also when the format rounds the value" tests it.

exceptions.title: rounds the stored value, not the compact text, on blur ($name)
exceptions.reason: With no typed edit, the blur rounds no value (see "should round to explicit maximumFractionDigits on blur"). The case "a rounding option of the format rounds the typed number at the blur, before the commit" tests a typed number.

exceptions.title: does not mark the field focused when the focus default is prevented
exceptions.reason: The browser cannot cancel `focus`, so `preventDefault()` has no native meaning there. The family has no `focused` state.

exceptions.title: does not reformat, touch, or commit on blur when the blur default is prevented
exceptions.reason: The browser cannot cancel `blur`, so `preventDefault()` has no native meaning there. `details.cancel()` cancels a change.

exceptions.title: ignores a change whose native default was already prevented
exceptions.reason: The browser cannot cancel `input`, so `preventDefault()` has no native meaning there. `details.cancel()` cancels a change.

exceptions.title: steps keyboard from dirty input text when the controlled value lags onValueChange
exceptions.reason: A controlled field that the parent does not write shows the value of its prop again, as `Input` does, so no typed text stays to step from. A typed number is the value at once, so a step after an edit starts from it: the case "a step after a typed edit starts from the typed number" tests it.

A typed number is the value at once, so a step after an edit starts from it: the case "a step after a typed edit starts from the typed number" tests it.

exceptions.title: warns in development when clipboard text cannot be read during paste handling
exceptions.reason: The paste is the native one: the browser puts the text at the selection, and the input reads no clipboard. `beforeinput` refuses a paste that does not give a number.

exceptions.title: reports an unchanged value once when a paste event carries no clipboard data
exceptions.reason: The paste is the native one, and the input reads no clipboard. A paste with no text gives no `input` event.

exceptions.title: starts the hold once a touch press settles and ignores the compatibility click
exceptions.reason: A held touch steps first at the first repeat, 460 ms after the press, and a tap steps at its click. A touch that becomes a scroll gets `pointercancel` before then (`test/measurements/number-field.test.ts`, "a touch that scrolls the page from a button sends pointercancel before 460 ms"), so no timer and no count of moves tell a hold from a scroll. The case "a touch press steps at the click of a tap, repeats after 460 ms when held, and does not step after a pointercancel" tests it.

exceptions.title: does not start the hold when the touch moves like a scroll
exceptions.reason: A touch that moves like a scroll gets `pointercancel`, and the hold ends with no step. The case "a touch press steps at the click of a tap, repeats after 460 ms when held, and does not step after a pointercancel" tests it.

exceptions.title: treats a touch press with several small moves as a tap
exceptions.reason: A touch steps at its click, whatever its moves. The case "a touch press steps at the click of a tap, repeats after 460 ms when held, and does not step after a pointercancel" tests it.

exceptions.title: adds [data-focused] attribute on every focus
exceptions.reason: The family has no `focused` state and no `data-focused`: `:focus` on the input and `:focus-within` on the root.

exceptions.title: is removed when the focused input becomes disabled
exceptions.reason: The family has no `data-focused`: `:focus` and `:focus-within` follow the focus.

exceptions.title: is removed when the focused input unmounts
exceptions.reason: The family has no `data-focused`: `:focus` and `:focus-within` follow the focus.

exceptions.title: validates the autofilled value even when the change is canceled
exceptions.reason: A cancelled fill changes nothing and tells the field nothing. The case "a fill of a disabled or read-only field, and a cancelled fill, change nothing" tests it.

exceptions.title: blocks submission when step mismatch occurs with default step
exceptions.reason: With no `step`, the hidden input has `step="any"`, so the form accepts each number. `:step="1"` gives the constraint of Base UI. The case "with min and step, the form refuses a number off the grid; with no step it accepts each number" tests it.

exceptions.title: should use the default locale if no locale is provided
exceptions.reason: With no `locale` prop, the text has the locale of the nearest `LocaleProvider`, else `en-US`, on the server and in the browser. The case "the text has the locale prop, else the locale of the nearest LocaleProvider, and never the locale of the visitor" tests it.

CSS selects `:disabled`, `:read-only`, `:required`, `[aria-invalid="true"]` and `:focus`, so the input has no `data-disabled`, `data-readonly`, `data-required`, `data-invalid` and `data-focused`.

The button reads the element that it renders, so it has no `nativeButton`. The developer gives the button a text or an `aria-label`, so it has no default `aria-label`.
